rows.label: tlk502109_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey... Do you know who
tends this garden?

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0003
rows.name:
But this place is the cathedral
of the Acedian Pope.

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0004
rows.name:
I guess it would have the same stately
aura, no matter who tended it.

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0005
rows.name:
Even so, I can tell this garden is
truly cherished. Whoever tends it must
be a wonderful person.

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0008
rows.name:
So if you find the gardener, be sure
to pass on my compliments.

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0011
rows.name:
Understood. I'll make sure the
gardener hears it.

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0014
rows.name:
Well then, Hotaru-sama. Please take
this.

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0015
rows.name:
I'm sure the gardener would thank
you. Please accept this as thanks.

rows.label: tlk502109_msg0016
rows.name:
And I'm a little happy that you like
this cathedral... this garden too.
